changelog:
Initial release of log-collector—permanent log collection agent for multi-node clusters.

- Collects system and custom logs from all nodes every 3 hours via SSH/VPN; stores in logs.db with 30-day retention.
- Supports multi-node clusters with prioritized VPN fallback (Tailscale > WireGuard > WAN-SSH).
- Handles nodes with variable reachability using best-effort and error logging.
- Includes automated daily cleanup of expired logs and buffer transfer if gateway is offline.
- Configuration is externalized; skill provides detailed documentation, installation, and troubleshooting guidance.
